K-RETURN LAW (V15, 2026-09-13 — the author's "ribbon" diagnosis; the
minting ledger grew 14-16 codes/batch while the return path sat unused):
- Numbered K-codes return via the standing 3-batch rollback window
  (TRACKER header law) — IDENTICAL mechanism to palettes/GAR/FET/BRE:
  used in batch N → free again at N+3. N20 proved it (the N16 return:
  K08/K65/K78/K79/K81/K85/K86/K88/K89). The window was never the
  problem; the minting default was.
- RETURNS BEFORE MINTS: a batch draws its K quota from the free return
  set FIRST. Theme-native minting (a new register the free set cannot
  express) is the EXCEPTION, justified in the batch header — not the
  default.

  (the N24 mint was 16; the ribbon grows no faster than the window
  retires).

  момент блокирует почти все коды; утилизация ~100% значит «занято окном»,

  ПЛЮС регистровая проблема: старые коды — shape-поэзия, карте цензуры
  нужны mechanics-first носители. BRE32-40 написаны механиками; старые
  остаются в ротации. Опять оба инструмента.

- ENV/OAS: проза победила коды — это узаконено (§15). MAT спит до
